notes.subject: סירותיכם / סירתיכם
notes.rationale: pot o thorn — dispela ves i had tumas: samba ol i tok 'ol pot bilong yupela' o 'ol thorn bilong yupela'.

notes.subject: כמו חי כמו חרון
notes.rationale: tupela 'olsem' — grin yet na bren — i go wantaim; repitisen i stap.

notes.subject: ישערנו
notes.rationale: win i ken kamap strongpela na wasim ol — 'pulim i go wantaim strongpela win'.

translation: Pastaim long ol pot bilong yupela i ken save long ol thorn, bai em i pulim ol i go wantaim strongpela win — olsem grin yet, olsem ol i bren i wantaim paia.

tokens.gloss: pulim ol i go wantaim strongpela win
